skill.summary: Generates real-time, logical product bundles and cross-sell offers from cart contents to increase average order value and reduce checkout abandonment.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of cart-bundle-aov-upsell

- Provides real-time bundle and cross-sell recommendations based on current cart contents to increase AOV and reduce checkout abandonment.
- Focuses on logical product pairing, new SKU launches, and compelling add-on suggestions.
- Outlines a strict workflow: anchor SKUs, map complements, define bundle rationale, and generate actionable upsell copy.
- Includes a mandatory output table per bundle with main product, complement, rationale, and one-click CTA.
- Notes clear usage limits (exclude SEO-only or unrelated compliance tasks).
- Offers implementation guidance for where to display bundle suggestions (cart, checkout, post-purchase, etc.).
